6: type UnknownRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

8: type RiskClassLabel = 'R1' | 'R2' | 'R3';

10: interface CapabilityBlockResult {
11:   blocked: true;
12:   reason: 'capability_not_allowed';
13:   riskClass: RiskClassLabel;

16:   safeNextStep: string;
17:   rollback: string;
18: }

20: function mapBrainRiskToRiskClass(risk: BrainCapabilityRisk): RiskClassLabel {
21:   if (risk === 'critical') return 'R3';
22:   if (risk === 'high') return 'R2';
23:   return 'R1';
24: }
25: 
26: function buildCapabilityBlockResult(tool: string): CapabilityBlockResult {
27:   const risk = getBrainCapabilityRisk(tool);
28:   const riskClass = mapBrainRiskToRiskClass(risk);
29: 
30:   const approvalRequired = riskClass !== 'R1';
31:   const escalation =
32:     riskClass === 'R3'
33:       ? 'human_operator_required'
34:       : riskClass === 'R2'
35:         ? 'workspace_owner_review'
36:         : 'none';
37:   const safeNextStep =
38:     tool === 'create_payment_link'
39:       ? 'redirect_to_manual_checkout'
40:       : tool === 'send_message'
41:         ? 'respond_without_tool'
42:         : 'use_allowed_alternative';

45:     blocked: true,
46:     reason: 'capability_not_allowed',
47:     riskClass,
48:     approvalRequired,
49:     escalation,
50:     safeNextStep,
51:     rollback: 'not_executed',
52:   };
53: }

55: function isCapabilityBlockResult(value: unknown): value is CapabilityBlockResult {
56:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
57:     return false;
58:   }
59:   const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
60:   return record.blocked === true && record.reason === 'capability_not_allowed';
61: }
